note: How Abhinav's local model router decides, and what broke. Facts copied on 2026-10-09 from ~/Desktop/Projects/local-agents-mcp (README.md, config/agents.json, ISSUES.md, last updated 2026-10-03) and from job-search-os/applications/perplexity-pm-2026-10/local-run-log.md. Draft: Abhinav has not approved this wording.

steps.name: Hand off a task
steps.what: From Claude Code, I choose what to delegate. Nothing goes to a local model unless I ask.

steps.name: Check who is available
steps.what: The gateway keeps only workers whose runtime answers and whose model is installed.

steps.name: Pick the worker
steps.what: A small cloud routing model, Jev, picks one worker from written criteria. It sees the task text only, not the context.

steps.name: Fall back if the router fails
steps.what: No key, a timeout or a bad choice: a fixed order takes over and the reason is recorded.

steps.name: Do the work
steps.what: One local model on the Mac gets the task and its context.

steps.name: Reject and retry
steps.what: An empty answer counts as a failure. The next worker is tried, two attempts at most, each once.

steps.name: Check the result
steps.what: Every answer says whether it was cut off. In Run Receipt, code recomputes the totals before anything is shown as final.

broke.what: A routed call returned nothing for 593 seconds.
broke.status: Cause not found. The client gave up and the connection dropped.

broke.what: The tunnel to the Mac dropped once, and a call failed at once.
Answers that take longer than 60 seconds are lost by the calling app.
broke.status: Worked around with a longer timeout, not fixed.

broke.what: The run log says ok when the caller never received the answer.

recordedRun: The recorded run on this page called the reviewer directly, with the routing step bypassed, after the routed attempt hung. It is a test of the local step and the checks, not of the routing.
callerNote: The caller is Claude Code, a cloud assistant, so anything I hand off has already been seen by it. The router keeps the context away from the routing model. It does not keep it away from the caller.
